name: Saki Datsumono Jan Eisui Joshi Hen
original_name: 咲だつもの雀 永水女子編
source:
A Saki eroge game featuring the girls from Eisui Girls' High School. Haru challenges Komaki, Hatsumi and Kasumi to a mahjong showdown. If Haru wins, the miko princesses must go through the traditional training of Kirishima's shrine maidens, servicing the shrine visitors. If Haru loses, the princesses will have some training with her instead.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.yaoyorozu-kobo.com/]official website[/url]]
translation:
以永水女子高中的女孩们为主角的咲工口游戏。春向小牧、初美和霞发起麻将对决。如果春获胜，巫女公主必须接受雾岛巫女的传统训练，为神社参拜者提供服务。如果Haru输了，公主们就会和她一起进行一些训练。

[翻译自[url=http://www.yaoyorozu-kobo.com/]官网[/url]]
